external_entities.name: Member
external_entities.description: A library member who uses the library app or a self-service kiosk to borrow, renew, reserve, or return books.
external_entities.source_excerpt: Members borrow, renew and reserve books through the library app on their phones.
external_entities.notes: Trust-zone placement is not stated for members or their phones.

external_entities.name: Desk staff
external_entities.description: Library desk personnel who extend loans, clear account blocks, or mark books returned through the circulation page.
external_entities.source_excerpt: Desk staff can extend a loan, clear a block on a member's account or mark a book as returned by hand
external_entities.notes: Everyone at the desk uses the same shared login; individual identity and branch cannot be determined from the history.

processes.name: Lending app
processes.description: The app on a member's phone that calls the lending API for renewals and reservations.
processes.source_excerpt: The app on their phone calls the lending API.
processes.notes: The app's technology and interface kind are not stated.

processes.name: Self-service kiosk
processes.description: A branch kiosk where members scan their library card and books, sending loans and returns to the lending API.
processes.source_excerpt: Every branch has self-service kiosks where a member scans their library card and the books they are borrowing or returning.
processes.notes: The kiosk technology and interface kind are not stated.

processes.name: Lending API
processes.description: The REST service that handles lending operations, applies loan rules, and reads and writes the loans database. It is the only component stated to read or write that database.
processes.source_excerpt: It's a REST API. JSON in, JSON out.
processes.notes: Exposure is disputed between the sources. Lending service note: 'The lending API is internal-only.' Interview transcript: 'The phones talk straight to the lending API over the internet.' Authentication is also an acknowledged gap: Priya said, 'I think it checks a token the app gets at sign-in, but I'd have to look.'

data_stores.name: Loans database
data_stores.description: The database containing members, loans, reservations, names, email addresses, home addresses, and full borrowing histories.
data_stores.source_excerpt: Names, email addresses, home addresses and every member's full borrowing history live in the loans database.
data_stores.notes: The former reservations database was merged into this database; the old reservations database is gone.

data_flows.name: request loan action
data_flows.description: A member uses the lending app to request a renewal or reservation.
data_flows.source_excerpt: Members borrow, renew and reserve books through the library app on their phones.
data_flows.data_description: A member's lending action, including the relevant book or title.

data_flows.name: renew or reserve
data_flows.description: The lending app calls the lending API with the member and book or title, and the API writes the change or queue entry.
data_flows.source_excerpt: The app on their phone calls the lending API. It says which book and which member, and the API checks the loan rules and writes the change.
data_flows.notes: The API's authentication behavior is unknown. Priya said, 'I think it checks a token the app gets at sign-in, but I'd have to look.'
data_flows.data_description: The member, book or title, and a renewal or reservation request.

data_flows.name: scan card and books
data_flows.description: A member scans their library card and the books they are borrowing or returning at a kiosk.
data_flows.source_excerpt: a member scans their library card and the books they are borrowing or returning
data_flows.data_description: A library card and book borrowing or return details.

data_flows.name: send loan or return
data_flows.description: A kiosk sends each scanned loan or return to the lending API.
data_flows.source_excerpt: The kiosks send each loan and each return to the lending API.
data_flows.notes: Priya could not say what the kiosks talk to other than what arrives at the API.
data_flows.data_description: A loan or return, associated with the scanned member and book.

data_flows.name: change loan record
data_flows.description: Desk staff use the circulation page served by the lending API to extend a loan, clear a block, or mark a book returned.
data_flows.source_excerpt: Desk staff can extend a loan, clear a block on a member's account or mark a book as returned by hand, through a circulation page the lending API serves.
data_flows.notes: The circulation page uses one shared login for all desk staff. The password is on a card taped under the desk, and the page does not ask again.

data_flows.name: read or write records
data_flows.description: The lending API reads and writes the loans database.
data_flows.source_excerpt: The API is the only thing that reads or writes it.
data_flows.data_description: Members, loans, reservations, contact details, addresses, and borrowing histories.

trust_boundaries.name: Branch network
trust_boundaries.description: The network on which the self-service kiosks and desk staff work.
trust_boundaries.source_excerpt: The kiosks sit on the branch network.

trust_boundaries.name: Council data centre
trust_boundaries.description: The council data-centre zone where the lending API and loans database run.
trust_boundaries.source_excerpt: The lending API and the loans database run in the council data centre.

trust_boundaries.name: Internet
trust_boundaries.description: The network over which phones are stated to talk directly to the lending API.
trust_boundaries.source_excerpt: The phones talk straight to the lending API over the internet.

assumptions.assumption: The loans database is confidential because it contains names, email addresses, home addresses, and full borrowing histories.
assumptions.basis: The interview explicitly states that these personal details and borrowing histories live in the loans database.

assumptions.assumption: The member holds or presents personally identifying information when using the lending service.
assumptions.basis: Members are identified through a library card and member account, and the service handles member information.

assumptions.assumption: The lending app handles personal and business-critical lending data.
assumptions.basis: The app sends the member and book or title to the lending API for renewals and reservations.

assumptions.assumption: The self-service kiosk handles personal and business-critical lending data.
assumptions.basis: The kiosk scans a member's library card and books involved in loans and returns.

assumptions.assumption: The lending API handles personal and business-critical lending data.
assumptions.basis: The API processes member and loan information and reads and writes the loans database.

assumptions.assumption: The member-to-lending-app flow carries personal and business-critical data.
assumptions.basis: The member requests borrowing, renewal, or reservation activity involving a member and a book or title.

assumptions.assumption: The lending-app-to-lending-API flow carries personal and business-critical data.
assumptions.basis: The interview states that the request identifies the member and book or title and changes a loan or reservation queue.

assumptions.assumption: The member-to-kiosk flow carries personal and business-critical data.
assumptions.basis: The flow carries the scanned library card and books involved in borrowing or returning.

assumptions.assumption: The kiosk-to-lending-API flow carries personal and business-critical data.
assumptions.basis: The source states that each loan and return is sent to the API.

assumptions.assumption: The desk-staff-to-lending-API flow carries personal and business-critical data.
assumptions.basis: The flow changes a member account, loan, or return record.

assumptions.assumption: The lending-API-to-loans-database flow carries personal and business-critical data.
assumptions.basis: The API reads and writes the database containing member details, loans, reservations, and borrowing histories.
